svg.title: Zava Forward executive architecture: 8 November source continuation
svg.desc: Retained core layout and icons; home sensors feed Basic B1 IoT Hub, Event Hubs and shared-API validated SQL telemetry/history. Read-only averages are computed on read; persisted per-home averages and quality-helper linkage are gated targets. A separate resident website has independently supplied SQL and optional public Sweden Central AI outside the core boundary. No new infrastructure adoption, live acceptance, diagnosis, consent or safety release is implied.

g.text: One workflow. Evidence first. People decide.
Zava Forward / executive architecture / 8 November 2026 continuation / original PR #68 layout
Connect staff, evidence and bounded AI support.
Keep resident choice and accountable approval with people.
Five bounded assists in this same API
Stock / assessment / funding / coordination / quality evidence
Five operator model paths and SQL restart persistence observed.
Normal five-assistant authority absent; proactive scans OFF.
Intended value: less chasing, fewer evidence gaps
Human consent, safety, quality and Finance gates stay in place.
Benefits need paired measurement; no production approval.
M365 and separate workers are not prerequisites for this core.
Solid green: documented core interaction / Blue: configured dependency / Purple dashed: conditional model path
8 NOVEMBER SOURCE CONTINUATION / HOME TELEMETRY + AVERAGES + RESIDENT WEBSITE
Current: exercise means computed on read from retained readings.
TARGET: stored per-home averages in existing SQL, separately gated.
No materialization worker, schema or quality-helper integration is built.
Averages are context, not diagnosis, consent, quality acceptance or safety release.
